# Banzami Developers

> Accept kwanza payments with Banzami: quickstart, API v1, SDK, webhooks and a reference implementation. Sandbox available; Financial Live unavailable.

- API: https://sandbox-api.banzami.com/v1 (Sandbox). Authentication: Authorization: Bearer bz_test_sk_… (project secret key, server-side only).
- Financial Live: unavailable (fail-closed). bz_live_ keys are refused.
- Amounts are integers in minor units: 100 = 1 Kz.
- Server SDK: @banzami/sdk (npm install @banzami/sdk), current version 0.13.0. OpenAPI: https://developers.banzami.com/developers/openapi/banzami-sandbox.openapi.json
- Portuguese pages: https://developers.banzami.com/docs · English pages: https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en

## Get started

- [Home](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en): Accept kwanza payments with Banzami: quickstart, API v1, SDK, webhooks and a reference implementation. Sandbox available; Financial Live unavailable.
- [Quickstart](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/get-started): Create and confirm your first Sandbox payment in twelve steps: account, project, Financial Setup, key, SDK, session and webhook.
- [How Banzami works](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/concepts): The integration model, Sandbox and Live, amounts in minor units, idempotency and request_id.

## Build

- [Accept payments](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/payments): Payment Sessions, Payment Links and QR: create, present and confirm a payment on your server.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/webhooks): Receive signed events: verify the signature, deduplicate, respond, replay and rotate the secret.
- [Refunds](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/refunds): Return a payment in full or in part, with idempotency, rules and errors.
- [Settlements](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/settlements): Settle an account balance to a beneficiary: gross, fee, net, fee destination and errors.
- [Receipts](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/receipts): SECURE_V1 proof references, public verification and how they differ from a transaction reference.
- [Accounts and transfers](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/transfers): Segregated accounts per campaign or store, and transfers between accounts of the same Business.
- [Build like DOA](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/doa): How a fundraising application integrates Banzami through the public contracts, from campaign account to settlement.

## Console

- [The Console](https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/console): Account, workspaces and roles, projects, Financial Setup, API keys, webhooks, logs and activity.

- DELETE /v1/sandbox/test-payers/{id} — scope sandbox:write; SDK retireTestPayer() — https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/reference#ref-test-payer-retire

## Webhook events

- payment_session.created: When a new session is created. Not emitted when the same purpose + reference returns a session that already existed. Fields: payment_session_id, destination_account_ref, amount_minor, currency, purpose, reference_type, reference_id, interfaces. — https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/events#event-payment_session-created
- payment_session.paid: When the payer pays the session and the money is in your account — at the same moment the session becomes PAID. Fields: payment_session_id, amount_minor, interface, destination_account_ref, reference_type, reference_id, transfer_id, acquiring_payment_id, refund_source. — https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/events#event-payment_session-paid
- payment_link.paid: When a link is paid — a link you created, or the link behind a Payment Session. Fields: id, slug, wallet_account_id, amount_minor, currency, description, status, paid_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, refund_source. — https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/events#event-payment_link-paid
- refund.completed: When a refund was made and the value is back with the payer — in the same request that createRefund answers 201. Fields: refund_id, source_type, source_id, amount_minor, currency, status, trace_id, created_at. — https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/events#event-refund-completed
- application_settlement.completed: When a settlement you requested finished: the net is with the beneficiary and the fee, if any, in your fee destination. Fields: id, owner_ref, status, gross_amount, application_fee, net_amount, currency, source_account_id, idempotency_key, created_at, completed_at. — https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/events#event-application_settlement-completed
- application_settlement.cancelled: When Banzami cancels a settlement that was created but never completed. No money left the account. Fields: id, owner_ref, status, source_account_id, idempotency_key, cancelled_at. — https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/events#event-application_settlement-cancelled
- application_settlement.failed: When Banzami marks as failed a settlement that could not complete. No money left the account. Fields: id, owner_ref, status, failure_reason, source_account_id, idempotency_key, failed_at. — https://developers.banzami.com/docs/en/events#event-application_settlement-failed

## Errors

Envelope: { code, message, request_id }. Branch on code. A 4xx error stays stored against the Idempotency-Key for 24 hours: nothing happened, and resending the same key returns the same error. Fix the request and use a new key. A 5xx, a 429 or a timeout is not stored: retry with the same key.

- UNAUTHORIZED (401): The key is missing, revoked or rotated, or is not a Sandbox key. bz_live_ keys are refused. Send Authorization: Bearer bz_test_sk_… with an active key, and confirm with GET /v1/me.
- INVALID_TOKEN (401): The credential is invalid or has expired. Use a valid key.
- AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE (503): The key could not be verified right now. This does not mean the key is invalid. Wait for Retry-After (2 s) and retry with the same idempotency key.
- INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (403): The key lacks the scope for this operation; the message names it. Create a key with that scope. An existing key’s scopes cannot be changed.
- FORBIDDEN (403): The credential cannot perform this operation: the scope is missing (on GET /v1/me) or the resource belongs to another project. Check the key’s scopes, and that the id belongs to your project.
- USE_FINANCIAL_SETUP (403): A project key does not read the Business state through this route. Use GET /v1/financial-setup (getFinancialSetup() in the SDK).
- MERCHANT_NOT_ACTIVE (403): The Business is not active, so it cannot create sessions or accounts. Check its status in the Console, under Financial Setup.
- PAYMENTS_UNAVAILABLE (403, 503): 403: the project has not completed Financial Setup and cannot receive payments. 503: the check could not be made right now. 403: complete Financial Setup and confirm with getFinancialSetup(). 503: retry with the same idempotency key.
- BINDING_CHANGED (409): The project’s Financial Setup changed during the request. Nothing was created. Retry with a new idempotency key: this response stays stored against the previous key for 24 h.
- FINANCIAL_SETUP_CONFLICT (409): The project’s Financial Setup is inconsistent and could not be evaluated. Contact support with the request_id.
- ENVIRONMENT_UNDECLARED (503): The service could not confirm the credential’s environment, because of a Banzami configuration fault. Retry later; if it persists, contact support with the request_id.
- INVALID_BODY (400): The request body is not valid JSON. Send valid JSON with Content-Type: application/json.
- BAD_REQUEST (400): A request field is invalid; the message names it. Correct the field named in the message.
- INVALID_REQUEST (4xx): The request was refused without a more specific reason. Read the message and correct the request.
- MISSING_FIELD (400): A required field is missing; the message names it. Add the field named in the message.
- INVALID_AMOUNT (400): The amount is not a positive integer in minor units. Send a positive integer: 100 minor units = 1 Kz.
- INVALID_CURRENCY (400): The currency is not a three-letter ISO 4217 code. Use AOA.
- INVALID_DESTINATION (400): The source and destination accounts are the same. Name two different accounts.
- INVALID_EXPIRY (400): expires_at is not in the future. Send a future date, in UTC.
- INVALID_METADATA (400): A metadata field exceeds the allowed format or length; the message gives the limits. Bring the field within the limits given.
- INVALID_PARAM (400): A query parameter is invalid, for example limit outside 1 to 100. Correct the parameter named in the message.
- INVALID_SOURCE_TYPE (400): source_type is neither ACQUIRING_PAYMENT nor WALLET_PAYMENT. Use the source_type from the payment’s refund_source.
- INVALID_WEBHOOK_URL (400): The webhook URL is not a public HTTPS endpoint, or is too long. Use a public HTTPS address. Private and loopback addresses are refused.
- UNSUPPORTED_EVENT (400): One of the requested events is not in the catalogue. Use only events from the event catalogue.
- PAYEE_NOT_ALLOWED (400): The request names the payee. With a project key, the payee comes from Financial Setup. Remove the field named in the message (merchant_id, wallet_id or payee).
- PRICING_FIELD_NOT_ACCEPTED (400): The request names a price or a fee. Pricing is assigned to the Business by Banzami. Remove the pricing field.
- PDF_NOT_SUPPORTED (415): The QR code is not available as PDF. Request format=png or format=svg.
- ROUTE_RETIRED (410): The route was retired; the message names the alternative. Use the route named in the message.
- NOT_FOUND (404): The resource does not exist, or belongs to another project. Both return the same response. Check the id, and that it belongs to this project.
- NO_LINK (404): The session has no payment link. Read the session’s interfaces and use the one available.
- NO_QR (404): The session has no QR interface. Read the session’s interfaces and use the one available.
- IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (409): This idempotency key was already used for a different request. Do not retry with this key: it belongs to the other operation. Use a new key.
- IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (409): On a request: another request with this key is still in progress. On a settlement: the key was already used for another settlement. Request in progress: wait and retry with the same key. Another settlement: use a new key.
- IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT (409): The idempotency key was already used on this payment with a different amount or currency. Retry with the original request, or use another key for a different refund.
- LINK_NOT_ACTIVE (422): The payment link is no longer active: it was paid, expired or was cancelled. Create a new link.
- WALLET_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE (409): The account that should receive the payment is not active. Use an active account.
- PRIMARY_NOT_CREATABLE (422): An account with purpose PRIMARY cannot be created: the main account comes with the wallet. Use another purpose, for example CAMPAIGN, STORE or EVENT.
- DELIVERY_ALREADY_SUCCEEDED (409): The delivery already succeeded and is not sent again. Replay only deliveries that failed.
- ACCOUNT_FROZEN (422): The account is frozen; movements from it are refused. Contact support with the request_id.
- ACCOUNTS_NOT_SAME_WALLET (422): The two accounts do not belong to the same wallet. Transfer only between accounts of the same Business.
- CURRENCY_MISMATCH (422): The accounts, the payment and the request do not share a currency. Use the account’s or payment’s currency.
- INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS (422): The source account does not have enough available balance. Check the balance and retry once there is enough, with a new key.
- NOTHING_TO_SETTLE (422): The source account has no available balance to settle. Settle once there is a balance, with a new key.
- SOURCE_NOT_SEGREGATED (422): The source is the Business’s main account; only a segregated account can be settled. Use the id of a segregated account, for example one with purpose CAMPAIGN.
- BENEFICIARY_NOT_FOUND (422): The beneficiary’s @banza has no active wallet in this currency. Check the beneficiary @banza.
- FEE_DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND (422): The @banza named for the fee has no active wallet in this currency. Check the fee destination @banza.
- FEE_DESTINATION_NOT_OWNED (403): The fee destination does not belong to your Business. Name an account of your own Business.
- FEE_DESTINATION_REQUIRED (422): The pricing profile applies a fee to this settlement and the request names no fee destination. Send feeDestinationBanzaName.
- FEE_DESTINATION_NOT_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT (422): The fee destination is not a Business account. Name the Business account that receives the fee.
- FEE_DESTINATION_NOT_ACTIVE (422): The fee destination account is not active. Contact support with the request_id.
- FEE_DESTINATION_KYB_NOT_APPROVED (422): The fee destination Business’s verification is not approved yet. Retry after approval, with a new key.
- FEE_DESTINATION_WALLET_UNAVAILABLE (422): The fee destination account has no active wallet in this currency. Contact support with the request_id.
- FEE_DESTINATION_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED (422): The fee can only go to an APPLICATION or PLATFORM account. Name an account of that type. The classification is assigned by Banzami.
- SANDBOX_VALUE_PERIMETER (422): A Sandbox test Business settles only to a test payer or another test Business, and its fee goes only to a test Business. Test value never reaches a real account. Name one of the project's test payers (POST /v1/sandbox/test-payers) as the beneficiary and your own test Business as the fee destination.
- FEE_EXCEEDS_GROSS (422): The calculated fee would exceed the gross being settled. Settle once the balance is larger, or contact support with the request_id.
- PRICING_NOT_CONFIGURED (409): The Business has no pricing profile yet, so the settlement cannot be calculated. The profile is assigned by Banzami: contact support with the request_id.
- PRICING_CONFIGURATION_ERROR (409): More than one pricing rule applies to this settlement. Contact support with the request_id.
- INVALID_STATUS (409): The settlement is in a state that does not allow this change. Check the settlement’s current state.
- SETTLEMENT_NOT_COMPLETED (422): The settlement was created but could not be completed. Retry with the same key: the existing settlement resumes and is never duplicated.
- SETTLEMENT_REJECTED (4xx): The settlement was refused without a more specific reason. Read the message and correct the request.
- REFUND_EXCEEDS_CAPTURED (422): The requested amount exceeds what is left to refund on this payment. The message gives the amount available; request at most that, with a new key.
- REFUND_NOT_FUNDABLE (422): The account that received the payment does not hold enough to return it. Retry once the account holds enough, with a new key.
- INVALID_PAYMENT_STATUS (422): The payment is in a state that cannot be refunded. Only a completed payment can be refunded.
- INVALID_TRANSACTION_STATUS (422): The transaction is in a state that cannot be refunded. Only a completed payment can be refunded.
- WALLET_NOT_FOUND (422): The wallet was not found: the one of the Business that received the payment, or — in a test payer's payment — the payer's. Contact support with the request_id.
- CONSUMER_WALLET_NOT_FOUND (422): The payer’s wallet no longer exists. Contact support with the request_id.
- REFUND_FAILED (4xx): The refund was refused without a more specific reason. Read the message and contact support with the request_id.
- RATE_LIMITED (429): Too many requests. Nothing was executed. Wait for Retry-After, then retry with the same key.
- INTERNAL_ERROR (500): A failure on Banzami’s side. Retry with the same key. If it persists, contact support with the request_id.
- QR_RENDER_FAILED (500): The QR image could not be generated. Retry the request.
- UPSTREAM_ERROR (502): A Banzami service failed. Your request may be valid. Retry with the same key.
- SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (503): The service is temporarily unavailable. Retry with the same key, with increasing backoff.
- UNAVAILABLE (503): The service is temporarily unavailable. Retry with the same key, with increasing backoff.
- SANDBOX_ONLY (403): The operation exists only in the Sandbox: test data, test payers, scenarios and test events. The key is not a Sandbox key. Use a bz_test_sk_ key from a Sandbox Project. Live has no test data.
- IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED (400): This request requires the Idempotency-Key header: a test payer top-up, or a payment with simulate TIMEOUT. Nothing was executed. Send Idempotency-Key with a value unique to the operation, then retry.
- INTERFACE_UNAVAILABLE (422): The session does not offer the interface named in via: no payment link, or no dynamic QR (an open-amount session is paid by link). Use via LINK, or create the session with the interface you want to test.
- PAYMENT_DECLINED (402): A Sandbox simulation requested with simulate DECLINED: the external rail declined. Nothing moved. The response carries simulated: true. Handle it as a real decline: tell the payer and allow another attempt. To pay, repeat without simulate.
- PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (503): A Sandbox simulation requested with simulate PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: the external provider is unavailable. Nothing moved. The response carries simulated: true. Handle it as a real outage: retry later with increasing backoff. To pay, repeat without simulate.
- SANDBOX_SIMULATED_TIMEOUT (504): A Sandbox simulation requested with simulate TIMEOUT: the payment was made, but the answer did not arrive in time. The client does not know the outcome. The response carries simulated: true. Do not pay again. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key to read the outcome, or read the session with GET /v1/payment-sessions/{id}.
- ENDPOINT_DISABLED (409): The webhook endpoint is disabled and receives no events, test events included. Enable the endpoint again and send the test event again.
- REALTIME_TOKEN_REQUIRED (401): The realtime status request carries no Authorization: Bearer bzst_… Send the session's realtime.token in the Authorization header.
- REALTIME_TOKEN_IN_URL (400): The status token was sent in the URL (query string). It is refused even if valid: a URL ends up in logs, history and Referer headers. Send the token only in the Authorization header, with fetch. Do not use EventSource with the token in the URL.
- REALTIME_TOKEN_INVALID (401): The status token is not valid: malformed, not issued by this environment, or altered. Read the session on your backend (GET /v1/payment-sessions/{id}) and use the realtime.token it returns.
- REALTIME_TOKEN_EXPIRED (401): The status token has expired. Tokens last at most 30 minutes and do not renew themselves. Read the session again on your backend for a new token, then reconnect.
- REALTIME_TOKEN_WRONG_RESOURCE (403): The status token belongs to another Payment Session. Each token opens only the session it was issued for. Use the token that came with this session.
- REALTIME_STREAM_LIMIT (429): Too many open status streams: at most 3 per session and 20 per IP address. Close the streams you do not use and wait for Retry-After. A page needs a single stream.
- REALTIME_UNAVAILABLE (503): Realtime status is not available right now. The payment is not affected. Fall back to reading the status with GET on your backend at a modest interval, and try the stream again later.
- STREAMING_UNSUPPORTED (406): The connection cannot stream right now. Ask for Accept: application/json for a single read, and try the stream again later.
- SANDBOX_QUOTA_EXCEEDED (429): A Project Sandbox limit was reached: 10 active test payers, or 20 top-ups and 10,000,000 in 24 hours. Retire test payers you no longer use, or wait for the 24-hour window to move. Nothing was created or funded.
- SANDBOX_FUNDING_REFUSED (422): The fictitious top-up was refused by the test payer's balance limits (5,000,000 at most). Nothing was funded. Top up a smaller amount, or spend the payer's balance first.
- TEST_PAYER_RETIRED (422): The test payer has been retired: it neither pays nor receives top-ups. Its history stays. Create a new test payer.
- RETIREMENT_FAILED (502): The test payer could not be fully retired right now. Nothing was left half-done that cannot be repeated. Repeat the retirement request.
- LINK_ALREADY_PAID (409): This payment link has already been paid. A single-use link does not accept a second payment. Read the session or link to confirm the existing payment; do not pay again.
- PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED (502): The money was transferred, but the payment could not be marked complete right now. Repeat the same request: repeating completes the payment and does not charge twice.
- QR_NOT_FOUND (404): The session's QR code was not found. Read the session and confirm it still offers DYNAMIC_QR; otherwise pay by link.
- QR_EXPIRED (422): The QR code expired together with its session. Nothing was paid. Create a new session.
- QR_ALREADY_USED (422): The dynamic QR code has already been used for a payment. A dynamic QR is paid once. Read the session to confirm the payment; do not pay again.
- AMOUNT_NEGATIVE (422): The amount sent for the QR payment is not valid. Omit amount_minor for a fixed-amount session, or send a positive integer in minor units.
- INVALID_WALLET_ACCOUNT (422): The wallet account that receives this QR code is no longer active. Check the account with GET /v1/wallet-accounts/{id} and create the session on an active account.
